C-APEX-MAGAZINE-STYLE.Summary: Apply the official Beyond the Apex light magazine presentation as a self-contained reader theme, explicitly requested after the reference review.

Goals.Goal: Match the verified official magazine: white canvas, black GT header and bA cover, pale chapter tiles and restrained borders.
Preserve content, language, retry, article navigation and original illustrations across desktop and phone layouts.

Constraints.Constraint: Use a reader-local Theme and existing Provider service; keep global UI, content loading and system-language behavior unchanged.
Respect macOS native controls, phone safe areas, 320px width and text scale1.5; retain accessible labels and readable illustrations without tint.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new API, automatic translations, global theme change, commit or push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Official cover leads the introduction without duplicate heading; black header, white reader and light contents match recorded references.
Chapters and articles remain navigable, narrow drawer closes on selection, previous/next and retry work.
RU/EN phone/desktop and enlarged-text tests pass, surrounding dark theme remains unchanged; quiet native screenshots and runtime inspection verify the result.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Dart MCP Apex tests and changed-file analyzer; localization audit and GRACE checks.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Mac and narrow iPhone screenshots, header safe area and contents/article interactions.
